meta.title: Where Are The Mega Startup IPOs?
meta.fullVoiceover: Jio ka IPO list ho gaya, par wait... Zepto, PhonePe aur Razorpay ke mega IPOs kahan gaye? Zepto ko investors se kam valuation mili, isliye unhone apna IPO seedha 2027 tak hold par daal diya hai. PhonePe ko SEBI approval toh mil gaya tha, par market volatility ke chakkar mein unhone bhi launch pause kar diya. Aur Razorpay ne confidential filing zaroor ki hai, par date ka koi ata-pata nahi. Ab in sabka target 2027 me shift ho chuka hai. Tum inme se kis IPO ka wait kar rahe ho? techwith.GenZ ko follow karke comments mein batao!
meta.instagramCaption:
🚨 Jio ka IPO toh list ho gaya, par India ke mega startup IPOs kahan gaye? 👇

1️⃣ Zepto: Investors se expected valuation na milne ke chakkar mein IPO plans seedha 2027 tak hold par daal diye hain.
2️⃣ PhonePe: SEBI approval mil chuka tha, par current market volatility dekh kar launch pause kar diya gaya hai.
3️⃣ Razorpay: June me confidential DRHP file ki thi, par abhi tak official date ka koi ata-pata nahi hai.

Ab in sabhi mega startups ka target seedha 2027 me shift ho gaya hai.

Aap inme se kis IPO ka sabse zyada wait kar rahe ho? Comments me batao 👇
Aur ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo IPO me invest karta hai 🔥

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily tech aur startup updates.
